events.title: Join-A-Ranger: Night Hike and Flashlight Tour
events.description: Enjoy a fun-filled Night Hike and Flashlight Tour of McClellan Ranch Preserve and Blackberry Farm! We will explore the woods and nature at night, learn about nocturnal animals' special adaptations, and test our heightened senses in the dark with games and activities. The hike is approximately one mile on a combination of dirt trails and paved paths. Please wear appropriate walking shoes and a warm jacket and bring a flashlight or head-lamp. All attendees must register and children must be accompanied by an adult. $10 Resident | $13 Non-resident
events.blurb: Walk McClellan Ranch Preserve after dark with a ranger, learning how nocturnal animals adapt to nighttime.

events.title: Brass Queens
events.description: Brothers Aaron and Lawrence Shaw, performing as Black Nile, see a different Los Angeles: not Hollywood's fantasy but a city of improvisation, fresh ideas and jazz, built on deep Black and Latino roots. Born and raised in LA's Inglewood neighborhood, they came up in the city's red-hot jazz scene, rubbing shoulders with elder legends and next-gen stars alike.
events.blurb: Hear Brothers Aaron and Lawrence Shaw, performing as Black Nile, play music inspired by a Los Angeles of improvisation, jazz, and Black and Latino roots.

events.title: Little Rams Leap: Ink Painting on Canvas (Children)
events.venue: Linn Studio behind the Triton Museum of Art
events.address: Linn Studio behind the Triton Museum of Art, 1505 Warburton Avenue, Santa Clara, CA 95050
events.description: In-person ink painting workshop for children ages 6-12 led by Mei-Ying Dell'Aquila, celebrating the Year of the Ram. All levels are welcome. The cost is $30 per person, and all materials are provided.
events.blurb: Make an ink painting on canvas with instructor Mei-Ying Dell'Aquila in a children's workshop for ages 6 to 12 celebrating the Year of the Ram.

events.title: Triton Holiday Art Fair
events.address: Triton Museum of Art, 1505 Warburton Avenue, Santa Clara, CA 95050
events.description: Indoor holiday gift fair with festive music and 25-30 vendors including local artists, small businesses, and nonprofits. Free to the public; RSVP is available on Eventbrite.
events.blurb: Browse indoor holiday gift booths from 25 to 30 vendors, including local artists, small businesses, and nonprofits, with festive music playing.

events.title: Ceremonial Check Presentation for Fire Truck Replacement Funding
events.address: Sunnyvale Fire Station Five, 1210 Bordeaux Dr, Sunnyvale, CA 94089
events.description: The City of Sunnyvale recognizes Assemblymember Patrick Ahrens for securing $1 million in state funding to replace aging fire trucks. The event includes brief remarks from Mayor Larry Klein, Public Safety Chief Daniel Pistor, and Ahrens, plus a ceremonial check photo opportunity. Parking is available at the station.
events.blurb: Watch Sunnyvale honor Assemblymember Patrick Ahrens for $1 million in state funding for fire truck replacement, with brief remarks and a ceremonial check photo.

events.title: Triton Book Club: A Christmas Carol
events.address: Triton Museum of Art, 1505 Warburton Avenue, Santa Clara, CA 95050
events.description: Book club discussion of Dickens' A Christmas Carol, with Executive Director Preston Metcalf presenting on the art and symbols of the holiday season. Free for Triton members, $5 suggested donation for non-members.
events.blurb: Join a discussion of Dickens' A Christmas Carol and hear Executive Director Preston Metcalf present on the art and symbols of the holiday season.
